install.notes: README.md:162-174 requires Isaac Sim 5.0 or 5.1, Isaac Lab 2.2.0 or 2.3.2.post1, Python 3.11, Linux Ubuntu 22.04+ and an NVIDIA RTX GPU. The gate and the fake backend need none of that: fake.py is pure Python, and the gate never installs or imports the upstream stack. The sim backend (gymnasium.make of a registered RoboLab environment) needs the upstream install and the built-in registration, and was not run.
